text: A May 2025 joint investigation by The Bureau of Investigative Journalism, The New York Times and Der Spiegel reported that more than a hundred consumer brands, 'from Apple to Volkswagen', can be tied to factories using Uyghur and other ethnic minority workers recruited through a system international authorities call forced labour; the Business and Human Rights Centre's summary of the reporting noted it is unclear whether the named companies source from the same factories. Apple said its suppliers are regularly independently audited, that recent audits found no instances of forced labour, and that it is investigating the alleged link.
short: TBIJ/NYT/Der Spiegel's May 2025 investigation reported that more than a hundred consumer brands, 'from Apple to Volkswagen', can be tied to factories using transferred Uyghur workers.
